items.title: George "Kid Sheik" Colar Interview, 1958-07-20
items.q: George the Boyd was playing, we got Milton Boyd, all that was old

ctx.x: And in those days, um, who were some of your other favorite musicians? For example, who was your favorite clarinet player then? Or the one that made the strongest impression on you whom you ever heard?

Well, I tell you, uh, at that time, George, your boy, was a clarinet player, really admired clarinet. In fact, uh, he was, uh, uh, I mean, uh, more, had been playing along with George, with George, uh, I believe, came up behind him. And George was waiting, Rene and all, and all, and all, and Punch was, I mean, uh, George was working with Punch and then when they was growing, and Punch was mostly famous before George was. And he was playing, playing, playing, playing at me. You know, you see, George mostly,…
Is there any clarinet player, nowadays, or a clarinet player, who was fortunate enough to get on records, whose style reminds you of George the Boyd's clarinet?
